data.long_meaning: Aala (عالی / آلاء) corresponds either to the Arabic ʿālā, 'high, exalted' (from the root ʿ-l-w), or to ālāʾ, 'blessings, bounties'. Because two distinct Arabic words share this transliteration, both senses are noted: ʿālā/ʿālī is 'exalted', while ālāʾ is 'blessings'.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name carries a sense of exaltation or blessing; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aala total 6, reducing to 6. Number 6 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aala mean?
faq.a: Aala means Exalted, high (ʿālā/ʿālī); also ālāʾ, blessings.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aala?
What language does the name Aala come from?
faq.a: Aala is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aala a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aala is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aala written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aala is written عالي in Arabic and عالی in Urdu, and आला in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aala?
faq.a: The root of Aala is ع-ل-و (ʿ-l-w).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aala?
Does Aala appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ālāʾ ('blessings') is a Qur'anic word.

faq.q: Is Aala the same as Aalaa (blessings)?
faq.a: They share a transliteration. ʿĀlā/ʿĀlī means 'exalted, high', while Ālāʾ (آلاء) means 'blessings, bounties'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aala?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aala total 6, reducing to 6. Number 6 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aala?
faq.a: Aala appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aalaa, Aalah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aala?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aala include Aalaa, Aali.
No. The gloss 'mountain' relates to a different Arabic word (jabal); Aala means 'exalted, high', or as Ālāʾ, 'blessings'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aala used today?
faq.a: Aala is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
